verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API at api.incident.io, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, a Terraform provider and a remote MCP server, but nothing names an official language SDK (e.g. Python, TypeScript or Go client libraries). A spec that developers can use to generate their own clients is a building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit; the probe also found no OpenAPI spec at the common well-known paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec to generate
